name: Marquis Lafayette
source:
“I’m not sure what it is you’re hiding, but I think it might be best if you give it up before his Highness finds out.”

Born in France.
Hobby: Collecting Asian Works of Art
Likes: Admiring Art
Dislikes: Music

A nobleman and soldier of France. A man with a strong sense of justice, he detests things that are twisted. He acts the same even to those of low social standing. He has sharper than average intuition and perception when it comes to his work, but he’s dense about everything else. He is friends with Count Fersen, and the two of them practice their swordplay together whenever the Count is in France.

[From [url=http://dreamer-chan.tumblr.com/post/145074546359/bara-ni-kakusareshi-verite-main-cast]Tumblr[/url]]
